remarks: Build your future on this affordable Cherry Valley Road parcel in the Allegany-Limestone School District. Ideally located between Ellicottville and Olean, this property offers the best of both worlds—approximately 15 minutes to the slopes, restaurants, shops, and year-round activities of Ellicottville, and 15 minutes to the conveniences of Olean. With generous road frontage and depth, there is plenty of room to build your dream home, vacation retreat, hobby farm, or country getaway. The quiet rural setting offers privacy, open space, and a peaceful lifestyle with minimal traffic. Whether you’re looking for a homesite, investment property, or a place to enjoy country living with room for animals and outbuildings, this property offers outstanding potential at an attractive price.
